author_substructure_requirements: A full job advertisement: duties, schedule, location, eligibility/certification, pay interval and work challenges. Treat minimum age/license endpoint, required versus preferred and season-specific days separately.
B community volunteering report; self-report about mindset/life not evidence that repair volunteering treats cancer.
C group association, reverse causation and multiple possible explanations, not causal chore prescription.
D design/process versus future industrial/prosthetic applications; uncertain human control not established clinical use.
source_quality_risks: A2license3+includesexactly3; optionBoverthree excludesendpoint. Cworkingweekends is also supported by springTuesday–Saturday schedule; requirement scope must be resolved, not inherited as unique gold.
Cstudyrelationship correlations and speculative mechanisms explicitly separate; causal benefits not established.
Dfutureprostheticattitude options optimistic/cautious and hopeful/worried close; word-level synonym differences do not establish unique gold.
Real organisations/research dates/claims not independently authenticated.
